Development contracts

Frame and accessibility

Base frame approximately 412 × 906 logical CSS px, using OnePlus 13’s 19.8:9 proportions. Official physical display: 1440 × 3168 pixels (oneplus.com/us/13/specs). This is not measured Android dp or an actual device viewport. Display/font settings, system and keyboard insets vary. Width is capped to available space; narrow, short and 200% text fixtures retain scroll fallback and 48px reference targets without shrinking type. System font scaling and reduced-motion preference remain authoritative for native implementation.

Locked interaction

Soft illumination is the only input treatment: lower edge for sign-in/Search; opposite top edge for list filters. Search places strongest matches nearest the bottom input, with upward continuation and keyboard/More access. The bottom tabs and any current-song mini-player stay visible when the keyboard is closed, even while Search has focus. The Keyboard footprint control simulates a visible soft keyboard: it hides bottom chrome without moving it above the keyboard or changing playback; native implementations should use actual IME visibility. History / Search / Playlists / Settings only; no Likes or type-helper strip. Listening rows and counts include available music only; genres are optional metadata.

Artwork caps: normal 330px, offline 280px, large text 164px. Album navigation sits above art. Centred timed lyrics match album/artist text (13.2px at base scale), scroll within a fixed-height area, and open full lyrics on tap. No player menu, lyric icon or scroll hint is shown; time labels align above Shuffle/Repeat. Plain/missing text never invents synchrony. The waveform itself is the seek surface; ordinary seek is only the missing-analysis fallback. Exactly five transport positions, with centred Play/Pause; output and Queue sit below.

Track/collection right swipe → Queue; only an upcoming occurrence left swipe → Remove. Mini left → Next, right → Previous. Finger-follow, captured binding, release-only commit, cancellation, reduced motion and named alternatives remain required. Mini underlay/current/neighbour faces all use the same surface. Latest-only top Undo lasts four seconds; exact occurrence/anchors/context guards apply. Remove, Undo and expiry must not replace the app/player/mini/lyric/seek nodes or reset queue scroll/focus.

Individual Queue is implicitly high; collections low. Deliberate Play replaces the queue with one rotated pass: selecting 3 from [1,2,3,4,5] plays 3,4,5,1,2, then stops with Repeat Off. Repeat Queue permits another round; Repeat One binds the exact occurrence. Queue and returning online never autoplay. Offline saved music and temporary cache are distinct; preserve safe preparation, cancellation, Retry and saved-data confirmation.

Colour tokens and account boundary

Account colours is a study, not the native palette catalog. Backgrounds, panels and artwork do not change with the palette. Primary marks actions and active states, including Play, selected tabs, saved-offline icons and input focus. The accent draws attention to the scrubber while dragging, the current lyric in the full lyrics view, or a popular track’s flame. Labels, shapes and state markers still carry meaning without colour.

Preview palette changes only the wireframe’s appearance, including on the sign-in sample. Settings → Account colours changes the in-memory choice for the current fixture account and returns the preview to Follow account. Fixture accounts are isolated by origin and immutable account ID; with no choice, Pulse Green is the study baseline. Nothing is stored or sent to a service.

Source feasibility and illustrative data

Reference derived from accepted feature sketch v4, SHA256 2c0fa908e84d2673b9fdce4961f34e24d53dc63c66c5d7d3c7f7fd53a3ff5f25. Exact bundled JetBrains Mono 400/500/600/700 and full local OFL remain embedded; Settings → Credits works offline. No sibling reference files or external assets are required.

All words, waveform shapes, ranking and listening occurrences are synthetic. Existing native Models/CatalogApi support optional genres and ordinary details/browsing, not listener lyrics/analysis/popularity/aggregate-insight or account-preference contracts. PlaybackService.sampleHistory is a no-op; native offline receipts are not implemented. History needs source/timing/licensing, coverage/timezone/retention and privacy reconciliation; a bounded retained server window cannot prove full-year completeness. Previously inspected backend history retains occurrences while recent deduplicates; recorded-history clear must coordinate pending receipts/replay ledger without automatic mutation replay. These are source feasibility notes, not deployment claims. Suggestions remain shelved.

The browser checks cover rendered reference behaviour, not native Android or real audio. This palette proposal does not change the app or service contract.
